scope_note: Primary papers and official proceedings used to freeze the rodent source family and assess direct methodological precedent. No restricted full text is redistributed.

limitations: No animal raw data were downloaded or reanalyzed.
Taste reactivity is a behavioral/causal anchor, not direct access to rat phenomenology.
The source family combines compatible constraints across studies; it is not asserted to be one complete biological circuit.
The prior-art search was targeted, not an exhaustive historical-priority search.
